flows.title: Send a campaign
steps: Go to Messaging, then New campaign.
Give the campaign a name for your own reference.
Write the message, including any link you want people to open.
Send the message, or schedule it for a later time instead of sending it now.

flows.title: Keep a message as a template and reuse it
steps: Go to Campaigns in the left-hand panel and click the New Campaign plus sign beside it.
Click Use template in the message box, then Add Template, and give the template a name for your reference.
Type the message the template should hold, then click Add Template to keep it.
To use it again, click Use template and pick it from the list; its text fills the message box.
A template belongs to the place it was made in, so a template made for an autoresponder shows up only among autoresponder templates.
To reuse a whole campaign instead, open the Campaigns tab, select a campaign, click the copy symbol at the top right next to the archive button, give the copy a new name and send it.
